title: Customer Onboarding & CME Profile Validation
description: As a CME Operations Officer, I need to create and validate commercial corporate accounts so that onboarding compliance criteria are verified.
acceptanceCriteria:
Corporate account number must follow ISO-13616 standard formatting.

Primary contact email must belong to an authorized enterprise domain.

Risk rating must default to "Medium" unless high-risk jurisdiction flags are triggered.

Account status must transition from "Pending" to "Approved" upon validation.

linkedTestCases.title: Verify successful corporate account creation with standard risk profile
linkedTestCases.description: Validates that submitting standard corporate credentials creates a persistent CME account.

steps.expectedResult: Dashboard loads with Create Account button enabled

steps.action: Enter corporate entity details and business registration number
steps.expectedResult: Entity details accepted without validation errors
Success toast is displayed and Account ID is generated
